content_sections.heading: Sikkim University Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Sikkim University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Sikkim University Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Sikkim University Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Assistant and 4 for Field Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Sikkim University Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Post Graduate Degree in Social Science with minimum 55% from a recognized University. Candidates having NET/SLET, PhD will be given preference. Field Investigator: Post Graduate Degree in Social Science/ Human Sciences from a recognised University.

content_sections.heading: Sikkim University Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Rs. 37,000/- per month (Consolidated) Field Investigator: Rs. 20,000/- per month (Consolidated)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Sikkim University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sikkim University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Sikkim University Recruitment 2026 is 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies, with 1 for Research Assistant and 4 for Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree in Social Science with a minimum of 55% from a recognized University is required. Candidates with NET/SLET or PhD will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Field Investigator?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary for a Field Investigator is Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for the selected candidates is scheduled for 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of Sikkim University?
faq.answer: The official website of Sikkim University is www.cus.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Sikkim University located?
faq.answer: Sikkim University is located in Gangtok, Sikkim, with the pincode 737102.
